# Nutrient Sign — Full Technical Reference

> This file provides comprehensive technical detail for AI coding assistants working on this codebase.
> For a concise overview, see [llms.txt](llms.txt).

## Project Identity

- **Name:** Nutrient Sign
- **Package:** `nutrient-sign`
- **Framework:** Next.js 16.1.6 (App Router, Turbopack, React 19)
- **Language:** TypeScript 5.9, strict mode
- **Deployment:** Vercel
- **Repository:** GitHub (private)

## Technology Stack (with versions)

- **Next.js** 16.1.6 — App Router, server components, API routes
- **React** 19.2.4 — Client components with `'use client'` directive
- **TypeScript** 5.9.3 — Strict mode, path aliases via `@/*`
- **Nutrient Web SDK** (@nutrient-sdk/viewer ^1.19.0) — PDF viewing, annotation, form fields
- **Nutrient DWS API** — Server-side digital signatures (CAdES B-LT)
- **Drizzle ORM** 0.45.1 — Type-safe PostgreSQL queries
- **Auth.js** (next-auth 5.0.0-beta.30) — JWT sessions, OAuth providers
- **AWS SDK v3** — S3 client for document storage
- **Tailwind CSS** 4.2.1 — Utility-first styling via @tailwindcss/postcss
- **Radix UI** — Dialog, AlertDialog, Dropdown, Select, Tabs, etc.
- **React Zero UI** — @react-zero-ui/core, @react-zero-ui/icon-sprite
- **Resend** — Primary email service (HTTP API, no npm package)
- **Upstash Redis** — Rate limiting (optional, gracefully disabled)
- **Biome** 2.4.4 — Linting and formatting
- **pnpm** — Package manager

---

## Complete Project Structure

```
app/
  (auth)/
    login/page.tsx                      # OAuth login page
    error/page.tsx                      # Auth error page
  (protected)/
    dashboard/page.tsx                  # Metrics cards, document overview
    documents/page.tsx                  # Document list
    documents/[id]/page.tsx             # Document detail view
    documents/[id]/components/          # DownloadButton, CancelButton, DeleteButton
    inbox/page.tsx                      # Documents awaiting user's signature
    send/page.tsx                       # Send-for-signature workflow
    send/components/DocumentFlow.tsx    # Multi-step wizard controller
    send/components/steps/
      DocumentSelection.tsx             # Step 1: Upload or select template
      RecipientConfig.tsx               # Step 2: Add recipients
      FieldPlacement.tsx                # Step 3: Place signature fields
      EmailCustomization.tsx            # Step 4: Customize email message
      ReviewAndSend.tsx                 # Step 5: Review and send
    send/components/steps/field-placement/
      use-viewer-setup.ts              # Viewer initialization hook
      use-drag-drop.ts                 # Desktop drag-and-drop
      use-touch-handling.ts            # Mobile/tablet touch handling
      utils.ts                         # Field creation utilities
      types.ts                         # TypeScript interfaces
      FieldOption.tsx                   # Draggable field palette item
      FieldList.tsx                     # Placed fields list with delete
    send/context/
      DocumentFlowContext.tsx           # Multi-step form state
      FormPlacementContext.tsx          # Recipient/field state
      ViewerInstanceContext.tsx         # Shared viewer instance ref
    signed/page.tsx                     # Completed documents
    templates/page.tsx                  # Template management
    trash/page.tsx                      # Soft-deleted documents
  api/
    auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts         # Auth.js endpoints
    avatar/[userId]/route.ts            # Profile photo proxy
    documents/
      route.ts                          # GET (list) / POST (create)
      proxy/route.ts                    # S3 document proxy (session + token auth)
      certificates/route.ts             # Download signature certificates
      [id]/route.ts                     # GET document by ID
      [id]/send/route.ts               # POST send to recipients
      [id]/resend/route.ts             # POST resend to recipient
      [id]/cancel/route.ts             # POST cancel document
      [id]/duplicate/route.ts           # POST duplicate document
      [id]/duplicate-data/route.ts      # POST get duplicate annotations
      [id]/fields/route.ts             # GET form fields
      [id]/recipients/route.ts          # GET/POST recipients
      [id]/delete/route.ts             # POST soft delete
      [id]/restore/route.ts            # POST restore from trash
      [id]/permanent-delete/route.ts    # POST permanent delete
      permanent-delete-all/route.ts     # POST empty trash
    sign/
      submit/route.ts                   # POST submit signature
      decline/route.ts                  # POST decline to sign
      verify-token/route.ts             # POST validate signing token
    templates/
      route.ts                          # GET (list) / POST (create)
      delete/route.ts                   # POST delete template
      download/route.ts                 # GET download template
      download/stream/route.ts          # GET stream template
    upload/
      route.ts                          # POST upload to S3
      presigned-url/route.ts            # POST get presigned S3 URL
  sign/
    [token]/page.tsx                    # Public signing page
    [token]/success/page.tsx            # Post-signing confirmation

components/
  ui/                                   # Base UI components (Radix + custom)
    alert-dialog.tsx                    # Styled confirmation dialogs
    button.tsx, card.tsx, etc.          # Standard UI primitives
    document-viewer.tsx                 # Reusable document viewer component
    top-nav.tsx                         # Navigation with avatar
  layout/
    page-layout.tsx                     # Protected page shell
    page-content.tsx                    # Content wrapper with title
  nutrient-script.tsx                   # CDN script loader for Nutrient SDK
  sign-here-widget.tsx                  # Visual "Sign Here" indicator
  template-preview-dialog.tsx           # Template preview modal

contexts/
  session-context.tsx                   # Auth session provider

hooks/
  use-mobile.ts                         # Responsive breakpoint hook

lib/
  auth/auth-js.ts                       # Auth.js configuration
  digital-signing.ts                    # DWS API integration
  email-service.ts                      # Email sending
  nutrient-viewer.ts                    # PDF viewer wrapper
  s3.ts                                 # S3 client
  rate-limit.ts                         # Rate limiting
  logger.ts                             # Centralized logging
  config.ts                             # Environment config
  seed-system-templates.ts              # Template seeder (runs on startup)
  file-utils.ts                         # File helpers
  utils.ts                              # General utilities (cn, etc.)

  document-signing-schema.ts            # All document-related tables
  drizzle.ts                            # Database client initialization
  drizzle.config.ts                     # Drizzle Kit configuration
```

## Database Schema

### Enums

```
document_status:    DRAFT | PENDING | IN_PROGRESS | COMPLETED | DECLINED | CANCELLED
signature_status:   PENDING | SIGNED | DECLINED | CANCELLED
document_access_level: VIEWER | EDITOR | SIGNER | CC
signature_type:     ELECTRONIC | DIGITAL
```

### Tables

#### `documents`
| Column | Type | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| id | text (UUID) | Primary key, auto-generated |
| name | text | Document display name |
| template_id | text | FK → document_templates.id |
| owner_id | text | FK → users.id (CASCADE) |
| status | document_status | Default: DRAFT |
| document_file_path | text | S3 URL of original PDF |
| signed_document_file_path | text | S3 URL of signed PDF (set on COMPLETED) |
| document_file_hash | text | SHA hash |
| size | integer | File size in bytes |
| expires_at | timestamp | Optional expiration |
| require_sequential_signing | boolean | Default: false |
| deleted_at | timestamp | Soft delete (null = active) |
| created_at | timestamp | Auto-set |
| updated_at | timestamp | Auto-set |

**Indexes:** owner_id, status

#### `document_templates`
| Column | Type | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| id | text | Primary key |
| name | text | Template display name |
| creator_id | text | FK → users.id (null for system) |
| is_system | boolean | Default: false |
| template_file_path | text | S3 URL |
| template_file_hash | text | SHA hash |
| size | integer | File size in bytes |
| created_at | timestamp | Auto-set |

#### `document_participants`
| Column | Type | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| id | text (UUID) | Primary key |
| document_id | text | FK → documents.id (CASCADE) |
| user_id | text | FK → users.id (CASCADE) |
| access_level | document_access_level | VIEWER/EDITOR/SIGNER/CC |
| signing_order | integer | Default: 0 |
| is_required | boolean | Default: true |

**Constraints:** UNIQUE(document_id, user_id)

#### `signature_requests`
| Column | Type | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| id | text (UUID) | Primary key |
| document_id | text | FK → documents.id (CASCADE) |
| participant_id | text | FK → document_participants.id (CASCADE) |
| signature_type | signature_type | Default: ELECTRONIC |
| status | signature_status | Default: PENDING |
| access_token | text | UNIQUE — used in `/sign/[token]` URLs |
| requested_at | timestamp | Auto-set |
| signed_at | timestamp | Set when signed |
| digital_signature_hash | text | Hash of digital signature |
| signature_certificate_path | text | Certificate file path |

#### `document_annotations`
| Column | Type | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| id | text (UUID) | Primary key |
| document_id | text | FK → documents.id (CASCADE) |
| creator_id | text | FK → users.id (CASCADE) |
| annotation_data | jsonb | Full annotation payload |
| is_finalized | boolean | Default: false |
| created_at | timestamp | Auto-set |

#### `document_audit_log`
| Column | Type | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| id | text (UUID) | Primary key |
| document_id | text | FK → documents.id (CASCADE) |
| user_id | text | FK → users.id (nullable) |
| action | text | Action description |
| details | jsonb | Additional context |
| ip_address | inet | Client IP |
| user_agent | text | Client user agent |
| created_at | timestamp | Auto-set |

#### `document_notifications`
| Column | Type | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| id | text (UUID) | Primary key |
| document_id | text | FK → documents.id (CASCADE) |
| recipient_email | text | Email address |
| notification_type | text | Type of notification |
| is_delivered | boolean | Default: false |
| sent_at | timestamp | Auto-set |
| delivered_at | timestamp | Set on delivery |

## Signing Flow (Detailed)

### 1. Document Upload
- Client uploads PDF via `POST /api/upload` (direct) or `POST /api/upload/presigned-url` (presigned)
- File stored in S3 under auto-generated key
- Document record created in `documents` table with status DRAFT

### 2. Field Placement
- Owner opens FieldPlacement step in the send wizard
- Nutrient SDK loaded from CDN (`components/nutrient-script.tsx`)
- Viewer initialized with Form Creator interaction mode
- Owner drags signature/initials/date fields onto PDF pages
- Each field associated with a specific recipient via `customData.recipientEmail`

### 3. Send to Recipients
- `POST /api/documents/[id]/send` creates:
  - `document_participants` row per recipient
  - `signature_requests` row per signer (with unique `accessToken`)
  - Status → PENDING
- Emails sent via Resend/SendGrid with `/sign/[token]` link

### 4. Recipient Signs
- Recipient opens `/sign/[token]` → token verified via `POST /api/sign/verify-token`
- Document loaded through proxy: `GET /api/documents/proxy?key=...&signingToken=...`
- Recipient fills signature fields and submits via `POST /api/sign/submit`
- Signature request status → SIGNED, audit log entry created

### 5. Digital Signature (After All Sign)
- After the last signature, `after()` hook in submit route calls `applyDigitalSignature()`
- **Build API call:** Appends blank certification page to PDF
  - Form field: `'document'` → instructions reference: `{ file: 'document' }`
  - Returns modified PDF buffer
- **Sign API call:** Applies CAdES B-LT visible signature
  - Mode: `descriptionOnly`
  - Position: rect `[156, 316, 300, 160]` on appended page
  - Includes Nutrient logo (transparent, C2B8AE color)
  - Signer name: "Nutrient"
- Signed PDF uploaded to S3 under `signed/{documentId}.pdf`
- Document status → COMPLETED, `signedDocumentFilePath` set

---

## Authentication

### Configuration (`lib/auth/auth-js.ts`)
- **Strategy:** JWT (not database sessions)
- **Adapter:** Drizzle (for user/account persistence)
- **Providers:** Google (auto-config), Microsoft Entra ID (manual config)

### Key Callbacks
- **signIn:** Fetches Microsoft profile photo via Graph API, stores as base64 in `users.photo` column
- **jwt:** Reads fresh `image` URL from DB, guards against data URI bloat in cookies
- **session:** Injects `user.id` from JWT token into session object

### Avatar Handling
- Google: Direct URL from OAuth profile, served via Next.js Image
- Microsoft: Fetched from Graph API on sign-in, stored as base64 in DB, served via `/api/avatar/[userId]` proxy endpoint
- This avoids HTTP 431 errors from base64 photos bloating JWT cookies

---

## Document Proxy (`/api/documents/proxy`)

The proxy route streams PDFs from S3 and handles three auth paths:

1. **Signing token** — Looks up document via `signatureRequests.accessToken` join. More reliable than file path matching since multiple documents can share the same PDF.

2. **Template ID** — Direct template lookup when `templateId` query param present. Skips document LIKE query which can match documents created from the same template file.

3. **Session auth** — Finds document by ID (preferred) or file path (legacy LIKE fallback). Checks ownership or participant membership.

**Important:** The proxy checks `if (signingToken)` not `if (signingToken && !session)` — token auth works even if the user also has a valid session.

---

## Nutrient SDK Integration

### Script Loading
`components/nutrient-script.tsx` loads the SDK from CDN:
```
https://cdn.cloud.pspdfkit.com/pspdfkit-web@{version}/nutrient-viewer.js
```
Version controlled by `NEXT_PUBLIC_NUTRIENT_SDK_VERSION` env var.

### Viewer Wrapper (`lib/nutrient-viewer.ts`)
- `safeLoadViewer()` — Unloads existing instance, clears container, loads new instance. Injects dark mode toolbar toggle.
- `safeUnloadViewer()` — Unloads SDK and empties container DOM. Suppresses internal cleanup errors.
- `getNutrientViewerRuntime()` — Returns `window.NutrientViewer` with runtime type interface (Geometry, Annotations, FormFields, Immutable, InteractionMode).

### Mobile Hydration Guard
`use-viewer-setup.ts` prevents SDK initialization before `useIsMobile()` has hydrated. Without this, on phones the viewer loads into the desktop container (isMobile=false initially), then isMobile flips to true and the desktop container unmounts, corrupting the SDK state (GdPicture licensing error).

### Form Field Types
- **Signature** — `SignatureFormField` with `WidgetAnnotation`
- **Initials** — Same as signature but smaller (75px wide vs 150px)
- **Date** — `TextFormField` with current date as default value

### Custom Renderers
Per-recipient color coding applied via `customRenderers.Annotation` callback. Colors distinguish which recipient each field belongs to.

---

## Email Service (`lib/email-service.ts`)

- **Priority:** Resend (via `RESEND_KEY`) → SendGrid (via `AUTH_SENDGRID_KEY`)
- **Implementation:** Direct HTTP POST (no npm SDK packages)
- **Templates:** HTML with inline styles, Nutrient branding
- **Types:** Signature request, reminder, completion, decline notification
- **Tracking:** All sends recorded in `document_notifications` table

---

## Rate Limiting (`lib/rate-limit.ts`)

Optional Upstash Redis-based sliding window limiters:
- Upload: 10 requests/minute
- Send: 5 requests/minute
- Sign: 10 requests/minute
- General/Proxy: 60 requests/minute

When `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL` is not set, null limiters are returned (always allow).

---

## S3 Storage Patterns

| Path Pattern | Usage |
|-------------|-------|
| `{timestamp}-{hash}.pdf` | User-uploaded documents |
| `system-templates/{slug}.pdf` | System template PDFs |
| `signed/{documentId}.pdf` | Digitally signed PDFs |

S3 client uses virtual-hosted-style URLs for CORS compatibility.

---

## Infrastructure (Terraform)

`infra/main.tf` configures:
- S3 bucket with all public access blocked
- Bucket policy denying non-HTTPS transport
- CORS configuration (GET, PUT, POST, DELETE, HEAD)
- Origins configurable via `allowed_origins` variable

---

## Implementation Gotchas

1. **Unicode logo filename:** The Nutrient logo PNG has Unicode hair spaces (`\u200a`) around the multiplication sign (`\u00d7`) in its filename. Must use Unicode escapes in code.

2. **DWS Build API form field name:** The form field name must match the instructions reference. Use `'document'` as the field name and `{ file: 'document' }` in instructions.

3. **DWS Sign API appearance:** No font size/color/weight controls. Mode options: `signatureAndDescription`, `descriptionOnly`, `signatureOnly`. Rect dimensions and show/hide toggles are the main levers.

4. **JWT cookie bloat:** Microsoft profile photos as base64 data URIs can exceed browser cookie limits (HTTP 431). Photos are stored in DB and served via proxy endpoint instead.

5. **Document proxy LIKE query:** Legacy file path matching via SQL LIKE can match the wrong document when multiple documents share the same PDF. Always prefer ID-based lookup (pass `documentId` or `templateId` query params).

6. **Viewer container cleanup:** Must empty container DOM before reloading the SDK. `safeUnloadViewer()` handles this. Without it, "container is not empty" errors occur.

7. **System template seeding:** Runs on every server startup via `instrumentation.ts`. Idempotent — checks existing DB rows by `templateFilePath` before inserting.

8. **Soft delete pattern:** `documents.deleted_at` timestamp. Null = active, non-null = trashed. Permanent delete removes both DB row and S3 object.

---

## Environment Variables (Complete)

### Required
| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `AUTH_SECRET` | NextAuth encryption secret (`npx auth secret`) |
| `AUTH_GOOGLE_ID` | Google OAuth client ID |
| `AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET` | Google OAuth client secret |
| `DATABASE_URL` | PostgreSQL connection string |
| `RESEND_KEY` or `AUTH_SENDGRID_KEY` | Email service API key |
| `EMAIL_FROM` | Verified sender email address |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` | Application URL (for email links) |
| `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` | AWS credentials |
| `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | AWS credentials |
| `AWS_REGION` | AWS region (default: us-east-1) |
| `AWS_S3_BUCKET_NAME` | S3 bucket name |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_NUTRIENT_VIEWER_LICENSE_KEY` | Nutrient Web SDK license |

### Optional
| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `AUTH_MICROSOFT_ENTRA_ID_ID` | Microsoft OAuth client ID |
| `AUTH_MICROSOFT_ENTRA_ID_SECRET` | Microsoft OAuth client secret |
| `AUTH_MICROSOFT_ENTRA_ID_ISSUER` | Microsoft issuer URL |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_NUTRIENT_SDK_VERSION` | SDK version (default: 1.19.0) |
| `NUTRIENT_API_KEY` | DWS API key (for digital signatures) |
| `NUTRIENT_API_BASE_URL` | DWS API endpoint |
| `NUTRIENT_LOGO_URL` | CDN-hosted logo for signatures |
| `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL` | Upstash Redis URL (rate limiting) |
| `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN` | Upstash Redis token |

## Development Commands

```bash
pnpm dev                     # Dev server with Turbopack
pnpm build                   # Production build
pnpm build:analyze           # Build with bundle analysis
pnpm lint                    # ESLint
pnpm biome:check             # Biome lint check
pnpm biome:fix               # Biome auto-fix
pnpm db:generate             # Generate Drizzle migrations
pnpm db:migrate              # Run migrations
pnpm db:studio               # Drizzle Studio GUI
node scripts/reset-clean.mjs # Full reset (S3 + DB)
```
